enemies: Survive against level 53 Jogres and level 46 Harpie Bug Swarms.

st.t: Talk to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai on Karamja.
s: It's a nice village, where is everyone?
It sounds like just the challenge for me.

st.t: Search a marshy jungle vine south of Tai Bwo Wannai for some snake weed. If you want to do Zogre Flesh Eaters or Legends' Quest grab one for each as you will need them later.
Clean the Snake Weed and give it to Trufitus.
Search the palm trees north east of Tai Bwo Wannai for an Ardrigal herb. If you want to do Legends' Quest grab one extra as you will need it later.
Clean the Ardrigal and give it to Trufitus.
Search the scorched earth in the south of Tai Bwo Wannai for a Sito Foil herb.
Clean the Sito Foil and give it to Trufitus.
Search the rock for a Volencia Moss herb at the mine south east of Tai Bwo Wannai. If you plan on doing Fairy Tale I then take an extra.
Clean the Volencia Moss and give it to Trufitus.
Head north-east of the village, towards where you found the Ardrigal. At the end of the cliffs, follow the coast west to a pile of rocks. Tap the rocks to search them and enter the cave.
Get the Rogues Purse from the fungus covered wall in the underground dungeon. If you are planning on doing Zogre Flesh Eaters then take an extra.
Clean the Rogues Purse and give it to Trufitus.
Talk to Trufitus to finish the quest.
